conventions.convention: The geometry is a smooth time-oriented Lorentzian four-manifold with signature (−,+,+,+), its torsion-free metric-compatible connection, and averaged symmetrization with factor 1/2. Stationary carrier domains are nonempty, connected and open.

Length coordinates include x⁰=ct; metric components, ξ, Nξ and u=ξ/Nξ are dimensionless. Physical four-velocity is cu, physical acceleration is c²a, β=u/(kBT) has inverse-joule units, and TK=NξT has kelvin units.

M*>0 is rest energy in joules. The future massive shell carries a Borel measure defined by pushforward of d³q/E(q), where E(q)=sqrt(M*²+|q|²). Its units are J²; the shell sigma-algebra is Borel, without an assertion of completion.
Countable Choice is inherited by the geometric and Lebesgue-integration suppliers; unrestricted Choice is not asserted.

The invariant shell integral I uses d³q/E, whereas the observer-rest partition Z and probability law use d³q on the Lebesgue sigma-algebra. The positive reference action href is a phase-space unit convention, not an identification with Planck's constant.
Stationarity means the geodesic Liouville equation on the entire future massive shell. It is distinct from normalizability and makes no assertion of thermalization or physical realization.
The expanding FLRW example fixes a(s)=s/L₀ on (0,∞)×R³, with increasing s future-directed. Its curvature convention is R(X,Y)Z=∇X∇YZ−∇Y∇XZ−∇[X,Y]Z, yielding S=6/s².

load_bearing.statement: A selected stationary thermal carrier on a nonempty connected open Lorentzian domain consists of a smooth future timelike Killing field ξ and smooth positive temperature T; Nξ=sqrt(−g(ξ,ξ)), u=ξ/Nξ, β=u/(kBT), and TK=NξT, without initially asserting TK constant.

For a symmetric bilinear form A and covector b on a four-dimensional time-oriented Lorentz vector space, A(P,P)+b(P)=0 on the entire future shell g(P,P)=−M², M>0, implies A=b=0. On the entire nonzero future null cone it instead implies b=0 and A=λg.
The measures defined using any two smooth future orthonormal tetrads near an event agree on every Borel subset of its future massive shell.

For positive M*, α=1/(kBT), n, c and href, I=4πM*K₁(αM*)/α and Z=4πM*²K₂(αM*)/α are finite and positive. The stated rest momentum law is a probability measure; ζ=log(n href³c³/Z) gives J=nu and Tᵃᵇ=(ε+p)uᵃuᵇ+pgᵃᵇ, with ε=n(M*K₁/K₂+3/α) and p=n/α.

For smooth β and ζ on a connected open Lorentzian domain and M*>0, the geodesic Liouville field is tangent to the total future massive shell, and Lf=0 everywhere on that shell iff ∇(aβb)=0 and dζ=0. The shell normalizer is finite exactly when β is future timelike.

For the stationary thermal carrier data, β is Killing iff NξT is a positive constant TK. When this holds, β=ξ/(kBTK), ξ(Nξ)=0, a=d log Nξ, θ=0 and σ=0. Constant positive rescaling of ξ rescales Nξ and TK while preserving u and β.

A smooth nowhere-zero Killing field generates local isometries preserving the metric-selected connection, the field itself, curvature, their finite covariant derivatives, and the stated finite natural tensor constructions; no complete flow is assumed.
